rules.design_description: run_refs may be empty; result metrics must remain empty and design expectations labeled
rules.simulation_evaluation: run_refs must refer to completed actual software runs matching input revisions
rules.same_source: all four formats share the same EvaluationReport and metric definitions
rules.csv_units: split tables; retain project/scenario/run/object identity, base units and unknown values
rules.html: offline browser viewing; filters inspect saved data and do not execute a new simulation
rules.images: current presentation render with scene revision; AI preview never used as runtime proof
rules.project_package: separate .sfproj editable handoff; JSON report is not a recoverable snapshot
rules.scenario_comparison: No comparison required for a single initial-success run; leave comparison data empty/not applicable. A repair with a rerun references both actual runs and changed inputs.

optional_generation_context.rules: actual production metrics only from referenced runs; goals and actual quantities use the same selected unit/scope/window; software timing/FPS only if measured; initial target met may have exactly one run, no revised reference, empty changes/reasons and no comparison; missing/unrepairable conditions do not imply target met

field_usage.initial_and_revised_scenario_run_refs: Initial actual run when available; revised references optional and empty when initial target met or no repair run exists. Do not duplicate an initial RunId as a revision.
field_usage.changes_and_reasons: Empty for initial-success delivery; otherwise record actual changes or named inability/missing conditions.
field_usage.stop_reason: initial_target_met, repaired_target_met, missing_conditions, unrepairable_shortfall or finite_budget_exhausted, according to actual state.
